result.topic_en: Euler computes the bending moment at a point Y of a vibrating elastic lamina produced by the elementary forces acting on the arc FY, expressing it as a double integral of the second time-derivative of the displacement, and states that it must equal the moment of elasticity at Y.
result.transcription:
LAMINARVM ELASTICARVM. 455
progrediendo, ſumamus punctum $y$ variabile, pro
quo idcirco coordinatae
$Bx = X \text{ et } xy = Y$
nunc noſtrae erunt variabiles, huicque puncto $y$ in
directione $yx$ applicata ſit vis $= P\,dX$ cuius mo-
mentum reſpectu puncti Y erit
$P\,xX.\,Xx = P\,dX\,(x - X),$
ſumto ergo huius formulae integrali, momentum ab
omnibus viribus arcui $Fy$ applicatis oriundum erit
ob $x$ conſtans
$= x\int P\,dX - \int P\,X\,dX,$
quod quidem ita ſumi debet, vt euaneſcente abſciſſa
$Bx = X$ ſimul euaneſcat. Transferamus iam pun-
ctum $y$ vsque in Y fietque $X = x$ et $P = p$, con-
ſequenter momentum omnium virium elementarium
per portionem F Y reſpectu puncti Y erit
$= x\int p\,dx - \int p\,x\,dx = \int dx \int p\,dx$
$= \int dx \int \frac{K\,dx}{2bk}\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right) = \frac{K}{2bk}\int dx \int dx \left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right),$
quae duplex integratio ita eſt inſtituenda, vt ſum-
to $x = 0$ tam integrale
$\int dx \left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right)$, quam $\int dx \int dx \left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right)$
euaneſcat, quandoquidem puncto Y in ipſo termino
F ſumto, nullae plane vires adſunt vltra F agentes.

IX. Momentum ergo hoc modo inuentum
aequari debet ipſi momento elaſticitatis in puncto Y,
quatenus autem in figura hae vires elementares
deor-

items.quote:
Momentum ergo hoc modo inuentum
aequari debet ipſi momento elaſticitatis in puncto Y
items.english: Therefore the moment found in this way must equal the moment of elasticity itself at the point Y.
